pages.text: The crystalline blocks of the Jalsphire Realm have some warping properties embedded into them, which now leads me to wondering if this place was a holding cell or more here for a test of smarts for someone or something?
The charge input frame shares a similar recipe as usual
A weep gem is required for this charge, for what reason I require the tears of a Warp is beyond me.
"$(00A5FF)$(o)Would she cry for me if I asked her to?$(br)Or would she see me as another fool?"
The blueprint for the gateway are as follows:
pages.name: The Final Portal
